signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.codeHint: A grown-up will read it to you.
signIn.useEmail: I have an email and password

error.notRecognised: That did not work. Check it and try again.
error.tooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
error.locked: This account is paused. Ask your teacher to help.

today.title: Today
today.noneAfter: This is the only step today.

nothingDue.title: Nothing is due today
nothingDue.body: Everything you have learned is still holding. That is a real result, not an empty day.

nothingFits.title: Nothing fits today's time
nothingFits.body: There is work waiting, but none of it fits the minutes set for you. Ask your teacher for a longer session.

maintenance.title: Read to keep it
maintenance.body: You can read a passage you already hold. Reading is not tested and nothing is recorded from it.

askGrownUp.title: Nothing has been set for you
askGrownUp.body: Ask a grown-up to give you something to learn.

streak.none: Your first day starts whenever you begin
streak.grace: A missed day is kept for you — the run continues.

listen.title: Listen
listen.instruction: Listen to the recitation with the page open.

recall_first.title: Say the first words
recall_first.instruction: Say or write the first words before anything is shown.

rebuild.title: Rebuild the āyah
rebuild.instruction: Put the words back in order. The tray is shuffled after every word.

next_ayah_cue.title: What comes next
next_ayah_cue.instruction: Hear one āyah, then produce the one after it.

connect_chain.title: Connect the chain
connect_chain.instruction: Recite several āyāt in order, from a blank page.

oral_recitation.title: Recite aloud
oral_recitation.instruction: Recite aloud. A person listens to this one.

why.verificationOverdue: Your teacher is waiting to hear {unitId}.
why.recentLapse: {unitId} slipped {daysSinceLapse} days ago, so it comes before anything new.
why.dueReview: {unitId} is due — about {retrievability}% of it is still within reach.
why.weakJoin: The join at {unitId} is trailing the āyāt it connects.
why.joinNotYetRecorded: The join at {unitId} has never been practised, though both āyāt around it hold.
why.newMaterial: There is room today for something new.
why.newWithheldLoad: New material is held back: {dueLoadMinutes} minutes of review come first.
why.newWithheldTier: New material is not part of today's session.
why.maintenanceNeverRead: {unitId} has not been read since you learned it.
why.budgetSpent: Held back — today's minutes are already spent.
why.newCapped: Held back — that is enough new material for one day.
why.unknown: This is the next thing your memory needs.

practice.title: Practice
practice.recordedBody: Your work is saved. What comes next is set by the server, never by this screen.
practice.notRecordedBody: Something went wrong, so nothing was saved. Nothing has been counted either.

teacherWillListen.title: Your teacher will listen
teacherWillListen.body: This one is not marked here. A person listens to it and decides.

testMode.title: Test
testMode.body: No help and no hints. You will see how it went at the end.

testResults.title: How the test went
testResults.body: Every answer was checked on the server. Nothing on this screen decided it.

scaffold.full_text: The words are on the page

scaffoldReason.exercise_floor: This exercise asks you to produce it.
scaffoldReason.strength: This is what your memory has earned.

noAudio.title: No recitation recorded yet
noAudio.body: No reciter's audio is in the package for this passage, so there is nothing to play. Read the page instead.

listen.noTimings: Playing without a highlight: the word timings for this reciter have not been measured, and a guessed highlight would teach the wrong rhythm.

recallFirst.prompt: Say the first words of this āyah.
recallFirst.blankNotice: The page stays blank until you commit.

rebuild.wrongWord: Not that one — it is back in the tray.

nextAyahCue.prompt: You heard {cue}. Produce the one after it.

connectChain.prompt: Recite {count} āyāt in order, from a blank page.

oral.prompt: Recite this aloud for your teacher.
oral.consentNeeded: Recording needs a grown-up's permission. You can still send the request without audio.

quran.title: Qurʾān
quran.subtitle: Your pages, drawn in the ink you have earned.
quran.readNotice: Reading view: full ink, nothing hidden, nothing recorded.
quran.memoryNotice: Memory view: the ink is as deep as the evidence you have given.

notYetRecorded.title: This page is not in the package yet
notYetRecorded.body: The muṣḥaf layout for this page has not been loaded, so there is nothing to draw. Nothing is missing from your memory.

empty.title: No pages yet
empty.body: Once something is set for you, your pages appear here.

sync.offline: You are offline. Your work is saved on this device and will be sent when you are back.
sync.failed: Could not send yet — your work is still saved here.
sync.notCounted: Nothing is counted until the server has it.
